notes: Data rows end with a trailing comma (28 fields vs 27 header names); parsed with index_col=False. A plain pd.read_csv shifts every column by one. Use data/carobd.py:load().
Header spells the run-time column ENGINE_RUN_TINE; renamed to ENGINE_RUN_TIME.
Hours come from the ENGINE_RUN_TIME column (monotonic, whole seconds). The logger writes ~2.03 rows/s, so rows/3600 (the README's 1 Hz) overstates the duration about 2x.

Many consecutive rows repeat values: PIDs are polled round-robin, so each variable refreshes at ~0.55 Hz (median RPM value changes per second in non-idle files), not 1 Hz. A 30 s window holds ~15 fresh samples per PID.
